---
title: smalldocs 0.5.11
subtitle: Long names in the table of contents
date: 2026-11-13
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

A heading can be a long name with no spaces, such as a Rust constant
`DRAFT_SAFETY_NO_AUTHORITY_EXPANSION` or a path `crate::module::Type`. Reference pages have many such
headings. Before, the table of contents cut off the end of such a name, so two names that start the same
looked the same. A long category in the margin of a listing was cut off in the same way.

smalldocs 0.5.11 breaks such a name onto more lines, in the table of contents and in the list of
categories. So each name can be read in full.

## What changes for a site that uses none of it

Only the file `smalldocs.css` in `site_libs` changes. The pages are the same, apart from the version in
the tag `<meta name="generator">`. The Folio theme has the same rule for the table of contents, for a
site that still builds with an older smalldocs.
